problem: The helix-cli provides the tool surface (comments, tickets, library, inspect) that agents use inside sandboxes. The current comment helix has none of these tools. The Host Agent running in a sprite would need the same CLI access that the 10-step workflow agents have. The CLI itself may not need code changes, but its availability and installation in the sprite environment is a critical boundary.

files.why: CLI command for posting comments to tickets (hlx comments post). Host Agent in sprite would use this to post confirmation and reply comments. Endpoint: POST /api/tickets/{ticketId}/comments.
Comment subcommand router: list and post. Accepts --ticket flag or HELIX_TICKET_ID env var for ticket resolution.
Ticket commands: list, get, create, rerun, continue, artifact, bundle. Host Agent would use these to access other tickets for context.
Library access: list, show, comments. Host Agent needs this to browse research library for context-aware confirmations.
Runtime inspection: db queries, log retrieval, API calls. Gives Host Agent production context.
CLI main entry point. Registers all commands. Binary: hlx → dist/index.js.
Package: @projectxinnovation/helix-cli v1.3.4. Binary: hlx. Quality gates: typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (node test runner), build (tsc).

facts: CLI binary is 'hlx' published as @projectxinnovation/helix-cli v1.3.4
Comment posting: hlx comments post --ticket <ref> '<message>' → POST /api/tickets/{id}/comments
Ticket access: hlx tickets list/get/create with search, status filter, archive fallback
Library access: hlx library list/show/comments for browsing research reports
Inspect: hlx inspect db/logs/api for runtime data queries
CLI already installed in Vercel sandbox during native-phase.ts provisioning for workflow agents
Quality gates: typecheck (tsc --noEmit), test (tsc && node --test), build (tsc)
